description.fun: A muscle-bound, short-tempered dog that Kitakami's people honour with a statue as one of the Loyal Three, heroes said to have driven off an evil ogre. Legend says it was once small and weak, and its hunger for strength led it to Pecharunt, which tamed it with a toxic chain that pumped up its muscles. For a local hero, it's surprisingly greedy and arrogant.
description.guide: A Poison and Fighting-type Legendary Pokémon from The Teal Mask, one of Pecharunt's Loyal Three with Munkidori and Fezandipiti. The toxic chain around its neck gave it a powerful physique. The trio, a dog, a monkey and a pheasant, may draw on the Japanese folktale of Momotarō.
description.tagline: A greedy, chain-swinging dog hailed as a hero of Kitakami
